target_customer: Healthcare employers and staffing firms that pay to reach licensed nurses and allied health workers, plus the clinicians who use the free career app
problem: Hospitals and staffing companies struggle to reach and recruit licensed clinicians cheaply, and nurses lack a trusted community for jobs, credentials and advice.
business_model: B2B recruiting and marketing services sold to employers on top of a clinician network and consumer app
product_category: Healthcare worker career network and recruiting marketplace

founders.name: Anthony Scarpone-Lambert
education: University of Pennsylvania (nursing and Wharton), per YC page
founders.background_notes: Registered nurse and two-time Broadway performer per YC page.

founders.name: Jennifferre Mancillas
founders.background_notes: Nurse, named California 2021 Nurse of the Year and Johnson and Johnson Innovation Fellow per YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: A mobile marketplace app and a simple hardware light at founding; the later AI sourcing agent adds complexity but came after the batch.

defensibility.rationale: A verified clinician database and community could compound, but job and staffing platforms are numerous and clinicians multi-home.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition or copying found in sources opened.

market_need_then: Nurse staffing and burnout were acute topics in 2021 and the founders were nurses selling to nurses; specific spend data was not found.

identity.voice_and_tone: community oriented, by healthcare pros for healthcare pros

branding.brand_signature: Founder story of two nurses, one a former Broadway performer

rebrands.why: Per Daily Nurse interview, moved from a single product to a platform; an aggregator says trademark trouble expanding the Lumify Care name (unverified)

branding.community_and_virality: Founders received press in AJC, Daily Nurse and Nurse.org in 2023; the app markets a community of 200,000 plus clinicians per the YC page.

brand_strength.rationale: A rebrand in 2023 reset recognition; coverage is mostly founder profiles in nursing media.

pivots.from: uNight Light hands-free nurse light (as Lumify Care)
pivots.why: Technical.ly describes the marketplace app launch alongside the light in May 2022.

pivots.to: Career network and recruiting platform for healthcare workers (Adni)
pivots.why: Rename to reflect platform; later added AI sourcing and employer services.

outcome_analysis: Adni started as Lumify Care, a nurse light and marketplace, raised a 1.25 million dollar seed in May 2022, then renamed in 2023 and shifted toward employer recruiting with AI sourcing. It is active with a small team and no later rounds found; scale and financial results are not public.
notes: Seed 1.25M reported by Technical.ly; Daily Nurse reportedly agrees but its full text was not opened. Aggregators give totals of 1.2M to 1.475M (including a 275K pre-seed) and CB Insights a June 2024 round; all unverified. adni.co returned 403. Competitors list empty: searches found no source dated near the 2021 batch; Doximity and AMN Passport appear only on undated profile pages. Headquarters is San Francisco per YC; one aggregator says Singapore (unverified). Founding year is 2021 per YC; aggregator says 2020.
